description: Defines a Flutter widget 'MoveList' for displaying a list of chess moves, including status indicators for checkmate and stalemate, and a helper widget '_StatusPill' for status display.

classes.name: MoveList
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a list of chess moves with status indicators.

classes.name: _StatusPill
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a colored label for game status (e.g., checkmate, stalemate).

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the MoveList widget UI, including move list and status indicators.

methods.name: _StatusPill.build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the status pill with label and color.
